code_summary: Intended architecture: one independently trained bidirectional MaskedSASRec per category, with tied input/output item embeddings, jointly trained item bias, 96 hidden units, two transformer blocks, two heads, dropout 0.2, and sequence length 64. The objective adds 0.1 times mean softplus(negative_logit − positive_logit) over the ten strongest valid entries among 256 shared sampled negatives, excluding target collisions and computing the ranking term in float32. Final-mask and auxiliary-position losses retain equal weighting. The predictor writer intends to strictly load one selected checkpoint per category with matching history processing; export parity and finite-gradient checks were present but never executed.
